_note: SAFETY HARD-BLOCK THRESHOLDS. Every value is DRAFT — conservative placeholders for prototype testing only. They must be reviewed against authoritative safety guidance before public launch. The app shows a warning banner while any threshold is draft.

thresholds.rationale: Very strong gusts make standing on exposed structures unsafe.
Large onshore waves at beaches, groynes and jetties.
Rock platforms: stricter limit — waves can sweep fishers off ledges.
Shore entries and exits become dangerous in swell.
Strong wind creates chop and surface drift for divers.
